rules.authority: 健康保険法 art.43の2, 厚生年金保険法 arts.23の2, 26 with 健保則 art.26の2 and 厚年則 art.10の2の2: "速やかに" (the 10th after the three months is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && has(row.to) && row.to != null
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row["from"] && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row["from"]) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "SOCIAL_ONLY"])

name: 育児休業給付金・出生後休業支援給付金 初回申請 (childcare leave benefit, first application)

rules.description: File through Hello Work the first childcare leave benefit application (with the 休業開始時賃金月額証明書), then each two-month unit as the employee asks.
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 arts.61の7, 61の10 with 雇用保険法施行規則 arts.101の30, 101の42: by the end of the month of the day four months after the first unit period begins (the leave's first day). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2). An extension entered as a new row continues the leave (row.chain_from) and raises no second first application.
rules.when: (has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["CHILDCARE_LEAVE"]) && !(has(row.chain_from) && row.chain_from != null && row.chain_from != "" && row.chain_from != row["from"])
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row["from"] && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row["from"]) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])

name: 出生時育児休業給付金 申請 (paternity leave benefit)

rules.description: File through Hello Work the 出生時育児休業給付金 (and 出生後休業支援給付金) application after the eight weeks from the birth.
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.61の8 with 施行規則 art.101の33: from the day after eight weeks from the birth (or the expected day if earlier; entry.facts.child_birth_date) to the end of the month of two months after it. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2). The 出生時育児休業 may be split in two (育児・介護休業法 art.9の2(2)) and one application covers both: a later period for the same birth (row.leave, facts.child_birth_date) raises none.
rules.when: (has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "POSTNATAL_PATERNITY_LEAVE") && !(has(row.chain_from) && row.chain_from != null && row.chain_from != "" && row.chain_from != row["from"]) && !(has(row.leave) && row.leave.exists(l, l.code == "POSTNATAL_PATERNITY_LEAVE" && has(l.id) && l.id != row.id && l["from"] < row["from"] && has(l.facts) && has(row.facts) && has(l.facts.child_birth_date) && has(row.facts.child_birth_date) && l.facts.child_birth_date == row.facts.child_birth_date))
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row["from"] && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row["from"]) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])

name: 介護休業給付金 申請 (family care leave benefit)

rules.description: File through Hello Work the family care leave benefit application after the leave ends.
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.61の4 with 施行規則 art.101の19: by the end of the month of the day two months after the day after the leave ends. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2). An extension entered as a new row continues the leave (row.chain_from) and raises no second first application.
rules.when: (has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "FAMILY_CARE_LEAVE") && !(has(row.chain_from) && row.chain_from != null && row.chain_from != "" && row.chain_from != row["from"])
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row["from"] && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row["from"]) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])

name: 高年齢雇用継続給付 受給資格確認・60歳到達時賃金証明書 (older worker continuation benefit)

rules.description: On reaching 60, prepare the 60歳到達時等賃金証明書; where the wage falls below 75% of it, file the first application (10% benefit from April 2025) and every two months after.
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.61 with 施行規則 art.101の5: the first application within four months from the first day of the first qualifying month (the month after reaching 60 is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && today == add_days(add_years(employee.date_of_birth, 60), -1)
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])

name: 育児時短就業給付金 初回申請 (shortened-hours childcare benefit)

rules.description: When a term of 育児短時間勤務 starts (terms.facts.childcare_short_hours), file the first 育児時短就業給付 application and every two months after (from April 2025).
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 arts.61の12–61の13 with 施行規則 art.101の48: within four months from the first day of the first qualifying month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] == today && has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.childcare_short_hours) && t.facts.childcare_short_hours == true)
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])

name: 退職所得の源泉徴収票・特別徴収票 (retirement income slip)

rules.description: Give the leaver the 退職所得の源泉徴収票・特別徴収票 (and file it with the tax office and the municipality for an officer); keep the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 for 7 years.
rules.authority: 所得税法 arts.203, 226(2) and 地方税法 art.50の9: within one month after the retirement (所得税法施行規則 art.77). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE", "DISMISSAL_NOTICE_ALLOWANCE"]

name: 給与支払明細書の交付 (pay statement delivery)

rules.description: Give every employee the pay statement of the payment (electronically only with the employee's consent).
rules.authority: 所得税法 art.231 with 施行規則 art.100: at the payment; electronic delivery needs the employee's consent (art.231(2)).

name: 法定調書の電子提出義務 (mandatory e-filing of statutory returns)

rules.description: File the statutory returns and the 給与支払報告書 by e-Tax/eLTAX or optical disc: required where the returns of a kind due two years before numbered 30 or more.
rules.authority: 所得税法 art.228の4 and 地方税法 art.317の6(5): 30 or more for returns due from 1 January 2027 (令和3年度改正); customer input: company.facts.statutory_return_count_two_years_prior. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: has(company.facts.statutory_return_count_two_years_prior) && double(company.facts.statutory_return_count_two_years_prior) >= 30.0

name: 特別徴収への切替届出 (switch of resident tax to special collection)

rules.description: Ask the municipality to switch the hire's resident tax from ordinary to special collection (特別徴収切替届出書); the municipality's 変更通知 sets the first month.
rules.authority: 地方税法 art.321の4(1)–(2): on the employee's request (employee.facts.resident_tax_special_collection_switch); the end of the hire month is the due day shown. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: employee != null && has(employee.facts) && has(employee.facts.resident_tax_special_collection_switch) && employee.facts.resident_tax_special_collection_switch == true

name: 就業規則の作成・届出 (work rules filing)

rules.description: Draw up the work rules, hear the majority union or representative (意見書) and file them with the labour standards office; refile on every change (company.facts.work_rules_filed_on records the latest filing).
rules.authority: 労働基準法 arts.89–90: an employer regularly employing 10 or more workers (headcount). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount >= 10 && !has(company.facts.work_rules_filed_on)

name: 雇止めの予告 (notice of non-renewal)

rules.description: Give 30 days' notice before ending a fixed-term contract renewed three or more times or held over a year, and a statement of reasons on request.
rules.authority: 有期労働契約の締結、更新及び雇止めに関する基準 (平成15年厚生労働省告示357号) arts.1–2 with 労働基準法 art.14(2) (exit_facts.renewal_count; service over a year).
rules.when: contract != null && contract.effective_range.to != null
rules.applies_when: has(contract.exit_ground) && contract.exit_ground == "END_OF_CONTRACT" && ((has(contract.exit_facts) && contract.exit_facts != null && has(contract.exit_facts.renewal_count) && double(contract.exit_facts.renewal_count) >= 3.0) || calendar_completed_months(hired_on, exit_on) >= 12)

name: 無期転換申込権の明示 (indefinite conversion right)

rules.description: A fixed-term employment has lasted five years: at the renewal state in writing the right to convert to an indefinite contract and the terms after conversion (from April 2024).
rules.authority: 労働契約法 art.18 and 労働基準法施行規則 art.5(5)–(6): the right arises where the total of fixed terms exceeds five years; the five-year day of this employment is shown (earlier fixed terms without a six-month gap also count).
rules.when: hired_on != null && today == add_years(hired_on, 5) && contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && has(t.employment_type) && t.employment_type in ["FIXED_TERM", "PART_TIME"])

name: 短時間・有期雇用労働者への特定事項の明示 (written specified terms for part-time and fixed-term workers)

rules.description: Give a part-time or fixed-term hire, besides the working conditions notice, the 特定事項 in writing — pay rises, retirement allowance, bonus and the consultation desk — and explain the measures on hire.
rules.authority: 短時間労働者及び有期雇用労働者の雇用管理の改善等に関する法律 arts.6(1), 14(1) with 施行規則 art.2.
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= hired_on && has(t.employment_type) && t.employment_type in ["FIXED_TERM", "PART_TIME"])

name: 年次有給休暇管理簿 (annual leave register)

rules.description: Record the grant (base date, days) in the annual leave register and the days taken; keep it five years (three for now).
rules.authority: 労働基準法施行規則 arts.24の7, 72 and 労働基準法 art.109, 附則 art.143: on each grant day. Only a grant made (the leave_balances entitlement): a grant refused for attendance has nothing to record.
rules.when: hired_on != null && calendar_completed_months(hired_on, today) >= 6 && today == add_months(hired_on, 6.0 + 12.0 * double(int((calendar_completed_months(hired_on, today) - 6.0) / 12.0)))
rules.applies_when: has(row.leave_balances) ? row.leave_balances.exists(b, b.code == "ANNUAL_LEAVE" && double(b.entitlement) >= 0.01) : true

name: 個人番号の提供の求め (My Number collection)

rules.description: Ask the hire (and the dependants on the declarations) for their individual numbers with identity verification, for the social insurance, employment insurance and tax filings.
rules.authority: 行政手続における特定の個人を識別するための番号の利用等に関する法律 arts.14(1), 16, 19(i): the employer as 個人番号関係事務実施者.

name: 退職証明書 (certificate of employment on leaving)

rules.description: Give the leaver the certificate of the period, work, position, wages and the reason for leaving (with the dismissal reason) without delay, stating only what was asked.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.22(1), (3): "遅滞なく" on the worker's request (exit_facts.certificate_requested); the last day is shown.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.effective_range.to != null
rules.applies_when: has(contract.exit_facts) && contract.exit_facts != null && has(contract.exit_facts.certificate_requested) && contract.exit_facts.certificate_requested == true

name: 男性の育児休業等取得状況の公表 (publication of men's childcare leave)

rules.description: Publish the men's childcare leave (and leave for childcare purposes) take-up rate of the business year just ended.
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 art.22の2 with 施行規則 arts.71の3–71の4: an employer regularly employing more than 300 from April 2025 (1,000 before), once a year for the previous business year (within about three months of its end per the ministry; company.facts.business_year_end_month). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount > 300 && has(company.facts.business_year_end_month) && int(period.key.substring(5, 7)) == int(company.facts.business_year_end_month) % 12 + 1

name: 次世代法 一般事業主行動計画の策定・届出 (next-generation action plan)

rules.description: Draw up, notify the labour bureau of and publish the general employer action plan (with numeric targets for men's childcare leave and working hours from April 2025); renew it when it expires (company.facts.next_generation_plan_until).
rules.authority: 次世代育成支援対策推進法 arts.12, 12の2 (as amended 2024): an employer regularly employing more than 100 ("遅滞なく"). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount > 100 && (!has(company.facts.next_generation_plan_until) || company.facts.next_generation_plan_until < period.from)

name: 女性活躍推進法 一般事業主行動計画の策定・届出 (women's advancement action plan)

rules.description: Draw up, notify and publish the women's advancement action plan on the employer's situation analysis; renew it when it expires (company.facts.women_action_plan_until).
rules.authority: 女性の職業生活における活躍の推進に関する法律 art.8: an employer regularly employing more than 100. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount > 100 && (!has(company.facts.women_action_plan_until) || company.facts.women_action_plan_until < period.from)

name: 中途採用比率の公表 (publication of the mid-career hiring ratio)

rules.description: Publish the mid-career share of regular hires for each of the last three business years.
rules.authority: 労働施策の総合的な推進並びに労働者の雇用の安定及び職業生活の充実等に関する法律 art.27の2 with 施行規則 art.9の2: an employer regularly employing more than 300, about once a year. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount > 300 && has(company.facts.business_year_end_month) && int(period.key.substring(5, 7)) == int(company.facts.business_year_end_month) % 12 + 1

name: 介護休業制度等の情報提供（40歳） (care leave information at 40)

rules.description: Give the worker who reaches 40 the information on care leave, care days and the benefits (from April 2025).
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(3) with 施行規則 art.69の8: in the business year (1 April–31 March) in which the worker reaches 40, or the year after; the end of that business year is shown.
rules.when: employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && today == add_days(add_years(employee.date_of_birth, 40), -1)

name: 介護に直面した労働者への個別周知・意向確認 (individual notice to a worker facing care)

rules.description: When a worker reports a family care need, tell them individually about care leave, care days and the benefits and confirm whether they will use them (from April 2025); the first care leave entry is the earliest record of that report.
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(2) with 施行規則 art.69の4 (from 1 April 2025): on the worker's report of a family member needing care.
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["FAMILY_CARE_LEAVE", "FAMILY_CARE_DAYS"]

name: 最低賃金の周知 (posting of the minimum wage)

rules.description: Post or otherwise make known to the workers the minimum wage that applies, its exclusions and its effective day, when a new regional minimum takes effect.
rules.authority: 最低賃金法 art.8 with 施行規則 art.6: the employer must make the applicable minimum wage known; the new amount's effective day is shown.

name: 労働関係書類の保存 (retention of employment records)

rules.description: Keep the leaver's worker register entry, wage ledger, attendance records and the hire, exit and wage documents until the date shown (five years from the exit; three years for now under the transitional rule), with the tax declarations for seven years from their filing deadline.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.109 with 施行規則 art.56 and 附則 art.143(1) (three years for now); 所得税法施行規則 arts.76の3, 77 (扶養控除等申告書 etc., seven years); 健康保険法施行規則 art.34 and 厚年則 art.28 (two years); 雇用保険法施行規則 art.143 (four years for 被保険者 records).
rules.when: contract != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: 育児休業等を取得しやすい雇用環境の整備 (childcare leave environment measures)

rules.description: Take at least one measure making childcare leave easy to take (training, a consultation desk, case information, a statement of policy), and choose two or more flexible-work measures for workers with a child from three to school age (art.23の3, from October 2025).
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 arts.21(1), 22(1) with 施行規則 art.71の2 (every employer from April 2022; care leave measures from April 2025, art.22(4)).

name: ハラスメント防止措置 (harassment prevention measures)

rules.description: Put in place the required measures against power, sexual and maternity/childcare harassment — a stated policy, a consultation system, prompt response and protection of those who consult — and the customer-harassment measures of the 2025 amendment once in force.
rules.authority: 労働施策の総合的な推進並びに労働者の雇用の安定及び職業生活の充実等に関する法律 art.30の2 (every employer from April 2022), 男女雇用機会均等法 arts.11, 11の3 and 育児・介護休業法 art.25, with the ministry's 指針.

name: 雇入時の健康診断 (health check at hire)

rules.description: Give a regularly employed hire the at-hire health check (unless one within three months is produced) and keep the individual record five years.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 art.66(1) with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.43, 51: on hiring a worker employed regularly (a short-time worker of three quarters or more of the full-time hours; 平成19年10月1日 基発1001016号).
rules.applies_when: !(contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= hired_on && has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) && double(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) < 30.0))

name: 定期健康診断 (annual health check)

rules.description: Give the worker the periodic health check within each year (every six months for night or hazardous work, 安衛則 art.45) and keep the record five years.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 art.66(1) with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.44, 51: "一年以内ごとに一回、定期に"; raised on each anniversary of the hire for a regularly employed worker.
rules.when: hired_on != null && today > hired_on && today.substring(5, 10) == hired_on.substring(5, 10)
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && !(has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) && double(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) < 30.0))

name: 定期健康診断結果報告書 (health check result report)

rules.description: Report the periodic health check results to the labour standards office after the month the checks are held (company.facts.health_check_month, customer input).
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生規則 art.52: an employer regularly employing 50 or more, "遅滞なく" (the month end is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount >= 50 && has(company.facts.health_check_month) && int(period.key.substring(5, 7)) == int(company.facts.health_check_month)

name: ストレスチェックの実施・報告 (stress check and report)

rules.description: Hold the yearly stress check, offer the doctor interview to high-stress workers on request, and report to the labour standards office.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 art.66の10 with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.52の9, 52の21: once a year at a workplace regularly employing 50 or more; held with the health checks here (company.facts.health_check_month). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.applies_when: headcount >= 50 && has(company.facts.health_check_month) && int(period.key.substring(5, 7)) == int(company.facts.health_check_month)

name: 扶養控除等申告書の受理 (dependant declaration for the coming year)

rules.description: Collect each employee's 給与所得者の扶養控除等（異動）申告書 for the coming year (with the 基礎控除・配偶者控除等申告書 for this year's adjustment) before the first pay of the year; keep them seven years. A hire files before the first pay (MY_NUMBER_COLLECTION).
rules.authority: 所得税法 art.194(1): "その年最初に給与等の支払を受ける日の前日まで"; arts.195の2, 198 for the year-end declarations; 所得税法施行規則 art.76の3 (seven years). Raised with the December run.

name: 妊娠・出産等の申出時の個別周知・意向確認 (individual notice on a pregnancy or birth report)

rules.description: When a worker reports a pregnancy or birth (the worker's own or the spouse's), tell them individually about childcare leave, 産後パパ育休, the benefits and the premium exemption, confirm their intention, and hear their wishes on working conditions (from October 2025); the first prenatal or paternity leave entry is the earliest record of that report.
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(1) with 施行規則 arts.69の3, 69の4 and art.21の2 (意向聴取, from 1 October 2025).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["PRENATAL_LEAVE", "POSTNATAL_PATERNITY_LEAVE"]

name: 非常時払 (emergency payment of earned wages)

rules.description: Pay the worker's request for the wages already earned for an emergency before the pay day.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.25 with 施行規則 art.9: on request, for the listed emergencies.
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "EMERGENCY_ADVANCE"

name: 時間外労働の限度時間 年360時間 (yearly overtime limit)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") != "NEW_TECH_RD" && sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= (has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) ? (period.month_key.substring(5, 7) >= company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) ? period.month_key.substring(0, 4) : string(int(period.month_key.substring(0, 4)) - 1)) + "-" + company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) : period.month_key.substring(0, 4) + "-01")).map(m, m.overtime_hours)) > 360.0
rules.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above 360 hours: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).
rules.description: 時間外労働の限度時間 年360時間 (yearly overtime limit)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(2)(iv), (4): 360 hours a year counted from the agreement's 起算日 (company.facts.overtime_agreement_from; else 1 January) over hours.months. 新技術・新商品等の研究開発 is outside the limits (art.36(11)). hours.months does not split approved rest-day overtime from the rest, so the count includes it and errs high.

name: 特別条項の上限 年720時間 (yearly cap under a special clause)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") != "NEW_TECH_RD" && sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= (has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) ? (period.month_key.substring(5, 7) >= company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) ? period.month_key.substring(0, 4) : string(int(period.month_key.substring(0, 4)) - 1)) + "-" + company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) : period.month_key.substring(0, 4) + "-01")).map(m, m.overtime_hours)) > ((has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") in ["DRIVER", "DOCTOR_A"] ? 960.0 : (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") == "DOCTOR_BC" ? 1860.0 : 720.0)
rules.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above the yearly cap even under a special clause (720 hours; 960 for drivers and A-level doctors, 1,860 for B/C doctors) (労働基準法 arts.36(5), 140–141).
rules.description: 特別条項の上限 年720時間 (yearly cap under a special clause)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(5); from April 2024 drivers 960 h (art.140), doctors by level (art.141 with 医師の労働時間短縮 省令) (company.facts.overtime_sector).

name: 複数月平均80時間以内 (2- to 6-month average cap)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") in ["GENERAL", "CONSTRUCTION"] && !(has(company.facts.disaster_recovery_work) && company.facts.disaster_recovery_work == true) && ((sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= add_months(period.month_from, -1).substring(0, 7)).map(m, m.overtime_hours - (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.worked_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0))) / 2.0) > 80.0 || (sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= add_months(period.month_from, -2).substring(0, 7)).map(m, m.overtime_hours - (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.worked_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0))) / 3.0) > 80.0 || (sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= add_months(period.month_from, -3).substring(0, 7)).map(m, m.overtime_hours - (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.worked_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0))) / 4.0) > 80.0 || (sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= add_months(period.month_from, -4).substring(0, 7)).map(m, m.overtime_hours - (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.worked_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0))) / 5.0) > 80.0 || (sum(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= add_months(period.month_from, -5).substring(0, 7)).map(m, m.overtime_hours - (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(m.day_type) && has(m.day_type.REST) && has(m.day_type.REST.worked_hours) ? m.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0))) / 6.0) > 80.0)
rules.message: Overtime and rest-day work average more than 80 hours a month over a 2- to 6-month span (労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii)).
rules.description: 複数月平均80時間以内 (2- to 6-month average cap)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii) over hours.months: each month’s overtime beyond the statutory limits plus every hour worked on a statutory rest day (法定休日, day_type REST: the approved overtime of those days is counted once, as rest-day work); work on another day off (所定休日, OFF) or a national holiday counts as overtime only where it exceeds the limits. Not applied to drivers, doctors, R&D or disaster recovery in construction (arts.139–141).

name: 45時間超は年6か月まで (at most six months above 45 hours)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) ? company.facts.overtime_sector : "GENERAL") in ["GENERAL", "CONSTRUCTION"] && size(hours.months.filter(m, m.month >= (has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) ? (period.month_key.substring(5, 7) >= company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) ? period.month_key.substring(0, 4) : string(int(period.month_key.substring(0, 4)) - 1)) + "-" + company.facts.overtime_agreement_from.substring(5, 7) : period.month_key.substring(0, 4) + "-01")).filter(m, m.overtime_hours > 45.0)) > 6
rules.message: More than six months in this agreement year have overtime above 45 hours (労働基準法 art.36(5)).
rules.description: 45時間超は年6か月まで (at most six months above 45 hours)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the special clause may exceed 45 hours a month in at most six months of the agreement year (hours.months from the 起算日).

name: 月80時間超の時間外・休日労働 (over 80 hours: notice and doctor interview)

rules.when: (work.overtime_hours + sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.worked_hours))) > 80.0
rules.message: Overtime and rest-day work exceed 80 hours this month: tell the worker promptly and arrange the doctor's interview on request (労働安全衛生法 art.66の8; 安衛則 arts.52の2–52の3).
rules.description: 月80時間超の時間外・休日労働 (over 80 hours: notice and doctor interview)
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 arts.66の8, 66の8の3 with 安衛則 art.52の2: the employer grasps everyone's hours (managers included) and informs a worker above 80 hours a month.

name: 年少者の時間外・休日・深夜労働 (minors: no overtime, rest-day or night work)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, period.to) < 18 && (work.overtime_hours > 0.0 || sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.worked_hours)) > 0.0 || sum(work.days.map(d, hours_between(d.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to))) > 0.0)
rules.message: A worker under 18 did overtime, rest-day or night work, which the law forbids (労働基準法 arts.60–61).
rules.description: 年少者の時間外・休日・深夜労働 (minors: no overtime, rest-day or night work)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.60(1) (no 36-agreement overtime or rest-day work) and art.61(1) (no work 22:00–05:00), with the listed exceptions.

name: 妊産婦の請求による時間外・休日・深夜の制限 (pregnant and post-partum workers)

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested) && terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested == true) && (work.overtime_hours > 0.0 || sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.worked_hours)) > 0.0 || sum(work.days.map(d, hours_between(d.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to))) > 0.0)
rules.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused did overtime, rest-day or night work (労働基準法 art.66).
rules.description: 妊産婦の請求による時間外・休日・深夜の制限 (pregnant and post-partum workers)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.66(2)–(3): on the worker's request no overtime, rest-day or night work (terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested).

name: 育児・介護のための時間外・深夜の制限 (childcare and care limits)

rules.when: ((has(terms.facts.childcare_overtime_limit_requested) && terms.facts.childcare_overtime_limit_requested == true) && (hours.month.overtime_hours > 24.0 || hours.year.overtime_hours > 150.0)) || ((has(terms.facts.no_overtime_requested) && terms.facts.no_overtime_requested == true) && work.overtime_hours > 0.0) || ((has(terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested) && terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested == true) && sum(work.days.map(d, hours_between(d.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to))) > 0.0)
rules.message: A worker who asked for the childcare or care limits did more overtime or night work than allowed (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 17, 19).
rules.description: 育児・介護のための時間外・深夜の制限 (childcare and care limits)
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の8 (no work beyond the schedule, to pre-school age from April 2025), art.17 (at most 24 h a month and 150 h a year), art.19 (no night work), on request (terms.facts).

name: 昼間学生の雇用保険適用 (daytime students outside employment insurance)

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.daytime_student) && terms.facts.daytime_student == true) && terms.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"]
rules.message: A daytime student is not insured for employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)); check the coverage on the terms.
rules.description: 昼間学生の雇用保険適用 (daytime students outside employment insurance)
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.6(iv) with 施行規則 art.3の2; a worker 65 or over with several jobs is insured only on application (art.37の5, マルチジョブホルダー).

name: 短時間労働者の社会保険適用 (short-time worker coverage)

rules.when: has(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) && double(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) >= 20.0 && double(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) < 30.0 && ((terms.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "SOCIAL_ONLY"] && (((has(company.facts.insured_full_time_workers) ? double(company.facts.insured_full_time_workers) : double(company.headcount)) <= 35 && !(has(company.facts.voluntary_special_application) && company.facts.voluntary_special_application == true)) || (has(terms.facts.daytime_student) && terms.facts.daytime_student == true))) || (terms.statutory_work_category in ["EMPLOYMENT_ONLY", "NONE"] && (has(company.facts.insured_full_time_workers) ? double(company.facts.insured_full_time_workers) : double(company.headcount)) > 35 && !(has(terms.facts.daytime_student) && terms.facts.daytime_student == true)))
rules.message: The coverage on the terms does not match the short-time rule: 20–30 weekly hours are insured at an employer of 36 or more (or under a 任意特定適用 agreement), not a student (健康保険法 art.3(1)(ix)).
rules.description: 短時間労働者の社会保険適用 (short-time worker coverage)
rules.authority: 健康保険法 art.3(1)(ix) and 厚生年金保険法 art.12(v) with 令和7年法律第74号 (wage requirement abolished 1 October 2026; the employer size falls to 36 in October 2027): company.headcount (contracts in force, standing in for the insured count), company.facts.voluntary_special_application; before October 2026 also the 88,000 monthly wage. The threshold is 平成24年法律第62号 附則 art.17(12) (a 特定適用事業所 has more than 50 特定労働者: insured persons under 70 who are not short-time workers), read with 附則 art.17の3の2 inserted by 令和7年法律第74号: more than 35 from 2027-10-01, 20 from 2029-10-01, 10 from 2032-10-01; 附則 art.17の3 ends the size test on 2035-10-01. The count is company.facts.insured_full_time_workers (the employer’s 特定労働者, as the pension office’s 特定適用事業所該当通知 states), else the entity’s contracts in force.

name: 減給の総額制限 (disciplinary reductions above one tenth)

rules.when: has(payslip.lines.DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION) && 0.0 - payslip.lines.DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION > 0.1 * (payslip.gross - payslip.lines.DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION)
rules.message: Disciplinary reductions exceed one tenth of the period's wages (労働基準法 art.91); carry the rest to a later period.
rules.description: 減給の総額制限 (disciplinary reductions above one tenth)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.91: in all at most one tenth of the wages of one pay period.

name: 賃金のデジタル払いの同意 (digital wage payment consent)

rules.when: has(terms.facts.wage_payment_method) && terms.facts.wage_payment_method == "DIGITAL" && !has(terms.facts.digital_payment_consent_on)
rules.message: Wages paid to a designated fund-transfer account need the worker's written consent (労働基準法施行規則 art.7の2(1)(iii)).
rules.description: 賃金のデジタル払いの同意 (digital wage payment consent)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.24(1) with 施行規則 art.7の2: payment through a 指定資金移動業者 only with the worker's consent after the required explanation.

rules.when: term.work_classification != "OFFICER" && has(company.facts.monthly_average_scheduled_hours) && (has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.workplace_region) ? term.facts.workplace_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region && term.base_salary > 0.0 && (has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.pay_basis) && term.facts.pay_basis == "HOURLY" ? term.base_salary : has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.pay_basis) && term.facts.pay_basis == "DAILY" ? term.base_salary / (has(term.facts.scheduled_daily_hours) ? double(term.facts.scheduled_daily_hours) : 8.0) : (term.base_salary + sum(term.allowances.filter(a, !(has(a.code) && a.code in ["FAMILY_ALLOWANCE", "COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE"])).map(a, double(a.amount)))) / double(company.facts.monthly_average_scheduled_hours)) < double(first(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.workplace_region) ? term.facts.workplace_region : company.region)].filter(e, e["from"] <= day)).amount) * (1.0 - (has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.minimum_wage_reduction_rate) ? double(term.facts.minimum_wage_reduction_rate) : 0.0))

rules.description: 最低賃金を下回る労働契約 (contract below the minimum wage)
rules.authority: 最低賃金法 arts.4, 7, 13 with 施行規則 arts.1–2: the minimum in force on the term's day (day) of the workplace's prefecture, less a permitted reduction, compared per hour.

rules.description: The workplace case kinds this version admits.

rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.61の7 with 雇用保険法施行規則 art.101の30(1)–(2): after the first application the employer files every two 支給単位期間 (each one month from the leave start day), by the end of the month of the day four months after the first day of the two units. Raised once per unit pair on the daily tick while a CHILDCARE_LEAVE row covers the day (row.leave; repeat_key = the leave start and the pair index), from the second pair. The units count from the start of the leave chain (row.leave chain_from): an extension entered as a new row continues the count. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.leave) && size(row.leave.filter(l, l.code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && l["from"] <= today && l["to"] >= today && int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) >= 2)) > 0
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"])
rules.repeat_key: size(row.leave.filter(l, l.code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && l["from"] <= today && l["to"] >= today && int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) >= 2)) > 0 ? first(row.leave.filter(l, l.code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && l["from"] <= today && l["to"] >= today && int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) >= 2).map(l, (has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]) + ":" + string(int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) / 2))) : ""
rules.due: size(row.leave.filter(l, l.code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && l["from"] <= today && l["to"] >= today && int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) >= 2)) > 0 ? first(row.leave.filter(l, l.code == "CHILDCARE_LEAVE" && l["from"] <= today && l["to"] >= today && int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) >= 2).map(l, next_working_day(month_end(add_days(add_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), 2 * (int(calendar_completed_months((has(l.chain_from) && l.chain_from != null && l.chain_from != "" ? l.chain_from : l["from"]), today)) / 2) + 4), -1)), holidays, ["SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"]))) : today

name: 育児時短就業給付金 支給申請 (two-monthly repeat)

Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (company.facts.working_time_regime). A worked day is a fact to correct, not to refuse: warn.

name: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.working_time_regime) ? company.facts.working_time_regime : "STANDARD") == "STANDARD" && int(calendar_distance_days("2023-01-01", day.date)) % 7 == ((has(company.facts.week_start_day) ? int(company.facts.week_start_day) : 0) + 6) % 7 && week.worked_hours > (has(company.facts.weekly_limit_44) && company.facts.weekly_limit_44 == true ? 44.0 : 40.0) && !(has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_to) && company.facts.overtime_agreement_to >= day.date && (!has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) || company.facts.overtime_agreement_from <= day.date))
rules.message: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(1), 36(1)).
rules.description: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force
rules.authority: 法定労働時間 1週40時間 (労働基準法 art.32(1)), 44 hours for a 特例措置対象事業場 (施行規則 art.25の2; company.facts.weekly_limit_44); the week is the calendar week from company.facts.week_start_day (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号), read on its last day.

name: Hours worked beyond 8 are not recorded as overtime: the premium is owed on them

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.working_time_regime) ? company.facts.working_time_regime : "STANDARD") == "STANDARD" && day.day_type != "REST" && day.worked_hours - 8.0 > day.overtime_hours + day.banked_hours + 0.01
rules.message: Hours worked beyond 8 are not recorded as overtime: the premium is owed on them (労働基準法 art.37(1)).
rules.description: Hours worked beyond 8 are not recorded as overtime: the premium is owed on them
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.37(1) (割増賃金 on every hour beyond the art.32 limits) and art.24 (full payment); 労働時間の適正な把握のために使用者が講ずべき措置に関するガイドライン (平成29年1月20日): the recorded hours, not the approved ones, are the working time.

name: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && size(day.intervals) > 0 && day.intervals.all(i, i.end != null) && day.worked_hours > 6.0 && (double(calendar_distance_days(day.intervals[0].start.substring(0, 10), day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(0, 10))) * 1440.0 + double(int(day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(11, 13)) * 60 + int(day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(14, 16))) - double(int(day.intervals[0].start.substring(11, 13)) * 60 + int(day.intervals[0].start.substring(14, 16)))) / 60.0 - day.worked_hours < (day.worked_hours > 8.0 ? 1.0 : 0.75) - 0.001
rules.message: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8 (労働基準法 art.34(1)).
rules.description: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.34(1): a break of at least 45 minutes where the working time exceeds 6 hours and 1 hour where it exceeds 8, within the working time; the break is the gaps between the day’s clock intervals. Not for managers (art.41).

name: No rest day in the week

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && int(calendar_distance_days("2023-01-01", day.date)) % 7 == ((has(company.facts.week_start_day) ? int(company.facts.week_start_day) : 0) + 6) % 7 && week.worked_days >= 7 && !(has(company.facts.variable_rest_days) && company.facts.variable_rest_days == true)
rules.message: No rest day in the week (労働基準法 art.35(1)).
rules.description: No rest day in the week
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.35(1): at least one rest day each week, unless the work rules use 4 rest days in 4 weeks (art.35(2); company.facts.variable_rest_days). Rest-day work needs a 36 agreement and the 35% premium (arts.36, 37).

name: Overtime approved for a worker under 18, which the law forbids

rules.when: has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date) < 18 && day.overtime_hours > 0.0
rules.message: Overtime approved for a worker under 18, which the law forbids (労働基準法 art.60(1)).
rules.description: Overtime approved for a worker under 18, which the law forbids
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.60(1): the 36 agreement (art.36) does not apply to a worker under 18; approving overtime for one is itself the forbidden instruction, so the file is refused (an emergency under art.33 is recorded as worked hours, not approved overtime).

name: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week

rules.when: has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date) < 18 && (day.worked_hours > 8.0 || (int(calendar_distance_days("2023-01-01", day.date)) % 7 == ((has(company.facts.week_start_day) ? int(company.facts.week_start_day) : 0) + 6) % 7 && week.worked_hours > 40.0))
rules.message: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week (労働基準法 art.60).
rules.description: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.60(1), (3): no variable-hours or 36-agreement extension for a minor beyond the art.60(3) exceptions.

name: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00

rules.when: has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date) < 18 && hours_between(day.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to) > 0.0
rules.message: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (労働基準法 art.61(1)).
rules.description: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.61(1): no night work for a worker under 18, except a male of 16 or over in a shift system (proviso) and the art.61(3)–(4) cases.

name: Overtime approved for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested) && terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested == true) && day.overtime_hours > 0.0
rules.message: Overtime approved for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused (労働基準法 art.66(2)).
rules.description: Overtime approved for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.66(2): on the request of an 妊産婦 (terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested) the employer shall not make her work overtime or on a rest day: the approval is refused.

name: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested) && terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested == true) && hours_between(day.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to) > 0.0
rules.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night (労働基準法 art.66(3)).
rules.description: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.66(3): no night work on the 妊産婦’s request.

name: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.no_overtime_requested) && terms.facts.no_overtime_requested == true) && day.overtime_hours > 0.0
rules.message: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 16の9).
rules.description: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8–16の9: a worker caring for a child before school age (from April 2025) or a family member who asks (terms.facts.no_overtime_requested) shall not be made to work beyond the scheduled hours: the approval is refused.

name: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested) && terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested == true) && hours_between(day.intervals, rules.night_work["from"], rules.night_work.to) > 0.0
rules.message: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (育児・介護休業法 arts.19, 20).
rules.description: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00
rules.authority: 育児・介護休業法 arts.19–20 (terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested).

name: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.hazardous_work) && terms.facts.hazardous_work == true) && day.worked_hours > 10.0
rules.message: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health (労働基準法 art.36(6)(i)).
rules.description: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: 坑内労働 and the listed harmful work may run at most 2 hours beyond the daily limit, even under a 36 agreement (terms.facts.hazardous_work).

name: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies

rules.when: day.rest_hours_before != null && day.rest_hours_before < (has(company.facts.work_interval_hours) ? double(company.facts.work_interval_hours) : (has(company.facts.overtime_sector) && company.facts.overtime_sector == "DRIVER") ? 9.0 : 0.0)
rules.message: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies (勤務間インターバル).
rules.description: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies
rules.authority: 労働時間等の設定の改善に関する特別措置法 art.2(1) (the employer’s duty to try to secure rest between shifts; company.facts.work_interval_hours, the interval its rules adopt); for drivers the 改善基準告示 (令和4年厚生労働省告示第367号) sets at least 9 hours (company.facts.overtime_sector DRIVER).

name: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.

rules.when: day.leave_code != "" && day.worked
rules.message: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.
rules.description: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.39 (annual leave is a release from the duty to work on that day) and art.108 with 施行規則 art.54(1)(ii)–(iii) (the wage ledger records the days and hours worked): a day cannot be both.

name: 適用事業所 名称・所在地変更届 (office name or location change)

rules.description: Notify the pension office (or the society) of the change in the office’s name or location.
rules.authority: 健康保険法施行規則 art.30 and 厚生年金保険法施行規則 art.23: within 5 days of a change in the business owner’s name, the office’s name or its location (entity name or region; row.before). The due day counts the day of the change, as the acquisition notice. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.before) && row.before != null && ((has(row.before.name) && row.before.name != row.name) || (has(row.before.region) && row.before.region != row.region))

name: 労働保険 名称・所在地等変更届 / 雇用保険 事業主事業所各種変更届 (labour insurance change)

rules.description: Notify the labour standards office of the change (労働保険 名称・所在地等変更届), then Hello Work (雇用保険 事業主事業所各種変更届).
rules.authority: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.4の2(2) with 施行規則 art.5 (the owner’s name, the business’s name, place or kind) and 雇用保険法施行規則 art.142: within 10 days counted from the day after the change (entity name, region or facts.ei_industry_class; row.before).
rules.when: has(row.before) && row.before != null && ((has(row.before.name) && row.before.name != row.name) || (has(row.before.region) && row.before.region != row.region) || (has(row.before.facts) && row.before.facts != null && has(row.before.facts.ei_industry_class) && (!has(row.facts.ei_industry_class) || row.before.facts.ei_industry_class != row.facts.ei_industry_class)))

name: Exit grounds

rules.authority: 労働基準法 第22条第1項 (退職時等の証明: the certificate states the ground of the exit, 退職の事由, including the reason for a dismissal), and the grounds this version’s notice, separation and insurance records compare (CEL employment.exit_ground).
rules.description: Why an employment ends (employment_contract.exit_ground, CEL employment.exit_ground): the grounds HR chooses from when it ends a contract. Every ground a record of this version compares is listed.

name: Holiday kinds

rules.authority: 国民の祝日に関する法律 第2条 (国民の祝日) and 第3条第2項 (振替休日: a holiday falling on a Sunday moves to the next non-holiday, SUBSTITUTE); SPECIAL_HOLIDAY is a day the entity observes beyond the Act (年末年始 and the like), priced by this version’s work records.
rules.description: The kinds an entity's holiday row may carry (holiday.kind, CEL work.days[].holiday_kind and holidays[].kind): every kind a record of this version prices or the public_holidays calendar writes.

name: 個人データ漏えい等 速報 (preliminary breach report)

rules.description: Report the personal-data leak to the 個人情報保護委員会 (速報).
rules.authority: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (facts.sensitive), property harm (facts.financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (facts.misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (facts.affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (facts.my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (facts.discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(1): promptly — the commission’s guidelines read it as about 3 to 5 days: due on the 5th day.
rules.when: has(row.kind) && row.kind == "DATA_BREACH" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && ((has(row.facts.sensitive) && row.facts.sensitive == true) || (has(row.facts.financial_harm) && row.facts.financial_harm == true) || (has(row.facts.misconduct) && row.facts.misconduct == true) || (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 1000.0) || (has(row.facts.my_number) && row.facts.my_number == true && (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 100.0)))
rules.due: add_days((has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.discovered_on) && row.facts.discovered_on != "" ? row.facts.discovered_on : row.opened_on), 4)

name: 個人データ漏えい等 確報 (final breach report)

rules.description: File the final report of the leak (確報).
rules.authority: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (facts.sensitive), property harm (facts.financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (facts.misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (facts.affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (facts.my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (facts.discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(2): within 30 days of discovery, 60 where the leak was made for an unlawful purpose.
rules.when: has(row.kind) && row.kind == "DATA_BREACH" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && ((has(row.facts.sensitive) && row.facts.sensitive == true) || (has(row.facts.financial_harm) && row.facts.financial_harm == true) || (has(row.facts.misconduct) && row.facts.misconduct == true) || (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 1000.0) || (has(row.facts.my_number) && row.facts.my_number == true && (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 100.0)))
rules.due: add_days((has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.discovered_on) && row.facts.discovered_on != "" ? row.facts.discovered_on : row.opened_on), has(row.facts.misconduct) && row.facts.misconduct == true ? 60 : 30)

name: 個人データ漏えい等 本人通知 (notice to the people affected)

rules.description: Notify the people whose data leaked (本人への通知).
rules.authority: 個人情報保護法 art.26(2) with 施行規則 art.10: promptly, on a reportable leak; 番号法 art.29の4(2).
rules.when: has(row.kind) && row.kind == "DATA_BREACH" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && ((has(row.facts.sensitive) && row.facts.sensitive == true) || (has(row.facts.financial_harm) && row.facts.financial_harm == true) || (has(row.facts.misconduct) && row.facts.misconduct == true) || (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 1000.0) || (has(row.facts.my_number) && row.facts.my_number == true && (has(row.facts.affected_count) && double(row.facts.affected_count) > 100.0)))
rules.due: (has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.discovered_on) && row.facts.discovered_on != "" ? row.facts.discovered_on : row.opened_on)

name: 年末調整の各種申告書の受理 (year-end declarations)

rules.description: Collect the 基礎控除申告書・配偶者控除等申告書・所得金額調整控除申告書, the 保険料控除申告書 and the 住宅借入金等特別控除申告書 before the year-end adjustment.
rules.authority: 所得税法 arts.190, 195の2 (基礎控除申告書, 配偶者控除等申告書, 所得金額調整控除申告書 — 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の4), 196 (保険料控除申告書) and 租税特別措置法 art.41の2の2 (住宅借入金等特別控除申告書): by the day of the last salary payment of the year, when the adjustment is made. Raised on the December run, due on its pay day.

name: 定年・継続雇用制度の整備 (retirement age and continued employment)

rules.description: Bring the work rules in line: a retirement age of at least 60, and below 65 a measure securing employment to 65 (raised age, continued employment for all who wish, or no retirement age); try to secure work to 70.
rules.authority: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.8 (a retirement age below 60 is void), art.9(1) (高年齢者雇用確保措置 to 65; company.facts.continued_employment_measure) and art.10の2 (高年齢者就業確保措置 to 70, an effort duty). Raised when the entity records a retirement age (company.facts.retirement_age) that breaches them.
rules.when: has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.retirement_age) && (double(row.facts.retirement_age) < 60.0 || (double(row.facts.retirement_age) < 65.0 && !(has(row.facts.continued_employment_measure) && row.facts.continued_employment_measure in ["RAISED_AGE", "CONTINUED_EMPLOYMENT", "NO_RETIREMENT_AGE"])))

name: 継続雇用の希望確認 (continued employment past the retirement age)

rules.description: Ask the worker reaching the retirement age whether they wish to continue to 65, and offer the continued employment the rules provide.
rules.authority: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.9(1)(ii): under a continued-employment system everyone who wishes is kept to 65. Raised three months before the worker reaches the retirement age (company.facts.retirement_age below 65), due the day it is reached (the day before the birthday, 年齢計算ニ関スル法律).
rules.when: employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && company != null && has(company.facts) && has(company.facts.retirement_age) && double(company.facts.retirement_age) < 65.0 && today == add_months(add_days(add_years(employee.date_of_birth, int(company.facts.retirement_age)), -1), -3)
rules.due: (employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && company != null && has(company.facts) && has(company.facts.retirement_age) ? add_days(add_years(employee.date_of_birth, int(company.facts.retirement_age)), -1) : today)

name: 毎月1回以上・一定期日払の原則 (wages at least monthly)

rules.when: has(company.pay_frequency) && company.pay_frequency == "INTEGER_MONTHS"
rules.message: Wages are paid less often than monthly: the law requires a payment at least once a month on a fixed day (労働基準法 art.24(2)).
rules.description: 毎月1回以上・一定期日払の原則 (wages at least monthly)
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.24(2): wages are paid at least once a month on a fixed day, except bonuses and the payments 施行規則 art.8 lists; an INTEGER_MONTHS pay frequency is for those only.

name: 産業医・衛生管理者の選任 (industrial physician and health supervisor at 50 workers)

rules.description: Appoint an industrial physician and a health supervisor (and a health committee) and report the appointments to the labour standards office.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 arts.12, 13, 18 with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.7(1)(i), 13(1)(i) and 2(2)/(13(2)): a workplace regularly employing 50 or more workers appoints both within 14 days of reaching 50 and reports without delay (様式第3号). Raised on a hire that brings the entity’s headcount to 50 or more, once (occurrence), unless the entity records the appointment (company.facts.industrial_physician_appointed_on). The headcount is the entity’s contracts in force; a multi-site entity counts each 事業場 (headcount_by_worksite).
rules.when: headcount >= 50 && !(company != null && has(company.facts) && has(company.facts.industrial_physician_appointed_on))

name: 年少者の証明書 (age certificate of a worker under 18)

rules.description: Keep at the workplace a certificate of the date of birth of the worker under 18 (住民票記載事項証明書).
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.57(1) with 年少者労働基準規則 art.1: the employer keeps at the workplace a certificate of the age of each worker under 18 (a 住民票記載事項の証明書 suffices; 昭和50年2月17日 基発83号). Raised on the hire of a worker under 18 on the hire day.
rules.when: employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && hired_on != null && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, hired_on) < 18

name: 雇用保険の適用 (employment insurance by weekly hours)

rules.when: has(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) && !(has(terms.facts.daytime_student) && terms.facts.daytime_student == true) && ((double(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) >= 20.0 && terms.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_ONLY", "NONE"]) || (double(terms.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) < 20.0 && terms.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "EMPLOYMENT_ONLY"]))
rules.message: Employment insurance coverage does not match the weekly hours: 20 hours or more a week is insured (雇用保険法 art.6(i)).
rules.description: 雇用保険の適用 (employment insurance by weekly hours)
rules.authority: 雇用保険法 art.6(i): a worker of under 20 scheduled hours a week is outside employment insurance (20 before 1 October 2028; 雇用保険法等の一部を改正する法律, 令和6年法律第26号, lowers it to 10 from that day); a daytime student (art.6(iv), terms.facts.daytime_student) is outside it whatever the hours. terms.statutory_work_category records the coverage.
